gbm_population_evidence.quote: Tissue confirmed diagnosis of high-grade glioma (World Health Organization grade III or IV)

gbm_population_flag.reason: Only 'high-grade glioma (WHO grade III or IV)' is named; grade IV glioma without IDH requirement treated as historical glioblastoma (D27C), otherwise high_grade_glioma_unspecified.

candidate_evidence.quote: Patients will participate in a 15-week program consisting of two weekly supervised exercise sessions combined with an individualized home exercise program and a modified Atkins diet.

coder_notes: Behavioural pilot (modified Atkins diet + exercise); no drug or biologic interventions, so agents is empty; diet is an excluded intervention type. Population: WHO grade III or IV high-grade glioma; grade IV glioma without IDH requirement read as historical glioblastoma (D27C) -> mixed_glioma_gbm_named, flagged because a stricter reading gives high_grade_glioma_unspecified. Trial fails S6 either way. Blood ketone outcome is a diet adherence marker, not a tumour biomarker. Treatment setting not stated (only those in initial chemoradiation are excluded).
